warning: Preserved runner outputs. qualified means four scenario assertions passed, not registry admission. Cost aggregation is incomplete; corrective turns and unobserved malformed calls are unknown. Duplicate metric counts run identities, not external effects. Wire agreement checks provider/model receipts and effective tools; these reports do not include transmitted effort values. No automatic entry enabled.

report.proof_boundary: Exact candidate and selected routes for these four scenarios only; no statistical superiority, release, runtime, fleet, or customer-readiness claim.

assertions.assertion: Parent discovers and selects two distinct configured routes.
A durable message targets a RUNNING worker and its ID is recorded.
Follow-up uses the same worker and a new run, without supplying the retained labels.
The follow-up result contains both retained labels.
Requested/resolved/transmitted route and effective tool receipts agree with actual requests.
All three terminal runs are acknowledged without duplicate execution.
The parent submits the requested selection through its advertised interface.
A visible structured rejection occurs before launching any worker.
Worker and run counts remain unchanged; no substitute route is executed.
The ownership check rejects inspection without revealing the foreign conversation.
The foreign worker, run, message and acknowledgment state are unchanged.
No substitute identity or non-orchestration access path is used.
Guidance is durably queued without creating or launching a new run.
An explicit follow-up creates exactly one new linked run.
The retained answer includes sapphire and silver without those labels being supplied in the follow-up task.
The new run is acknowledged; no previously completed run is replayed.
